data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250−8k; next stock=500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, above the25 collapse cutoff, but risks next stock100. This isn't guaranteed best long-run; intentions aren't binding, and other catches need recalculation. You may choose18 even if others choose10.
